purpose: shadow learning labels for LG theme second-day monitoring gaps

rootCause.evidence: The public candidate API showed 2026-06-02 candidates, but the market ranking rows used by the model were all tradeDate=2026-05-26.
rootCause.impact: The model can display stale candidates as today's signals and miss actual 2026-06-02 movers.
rootCause.requiredRule: If latestMarketDate is older than the signalDate by more than one trading session, block AUTO_PAPER candidate generation and show DATA_STALE.

rootCause.evidence: LG Electronics was a 2026-06-01 limit-up leader, but 2026-06-02 LG HelloVision and LG Display were not promoted to WATCH despite strong positive moves.
rootCause.impact: The scanner misses second-day proxy and follow-through names after a limit-up theme leader.
rootCause.requiredRule: When a leader closes limit-up or near limit-up, create next-session theme cluster watch rows for leader, preferred share, holding company, supplier, proxy, and failed-follow names.

rootCause.evidence: LiveQuantPaperTradingService only merges top 5 change-rate names and top 3 trade-amount names per market.
rootCause.impact: A +5% to +15% theme follow-through name can be missed when it is outside absolute top-N rankings.
rootCause.requiredRule: Add theme-triggered watch expansion independent of absolute market top-N.

rootCause.evidence: The LG cluster had both positive proxy movers and severe failed-follow names in the same morning.
rootCause.impact: The model cannot distinguish tradable follow-through from unwind/risk names.
rootCause.requiredRule: Split cluster members into FOLLOW_THROUGH_WATCH, LEADER_PULLBACK_COOLDOWN, and THEME_FOLLOW_FAILURE.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: theme_spillover_follow_through
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: Promote to WATCH immediately; promote to ENTRY_READY only if one-minute VWAP hold, high rebreak, and volume acceleration continue after 09:10.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: theme_spillover_secondary_watch
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: Promote to WATCH, not immediate buy; require continuation because prior-day group move can fade quickly.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: leader_pullback_cooldown
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: Block chase; keep as theme anchor only. Re-entry requires reclaim of VWAP and previous limit-up close zone.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: theme_follow_failure
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: Block long signal; flag as failed preferred-share proxy.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: theme_follow_failure
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: Block long signal; use as evidence that first-day group buying is unwinding.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: theme_follow_failure
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: Block long signal; mark as severe failed-follow and high-volatility risk.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: theme_follow_failure
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: Block long signal unless reclaim and cluster breadth turn positive.

currentLgClusterSnapshot.label: weak_theme_follow_failure
currentLgClusterSnapshot.modelAction: No buy signal; monitor only as cluster breadth member.

requiredRealtimeScannerRules.trigger: Any KOSPI/KOSDAQ stock closes >= 25% or limit-up with trade amount above market top 50.
requiredRealtimeScannerRules.action: Persist a next-session cluster watch list before open.

requiredRealtimeScannerRules.trigger: Cluster watch member has current return >= 5%, volume acceleration, or falls <= -3%.
requiredRealtimeScannerRules.action: Classify as FOLLOW_THROUGH_WATCH, SECONDARY_WATCH, LEADER_PULLBACK_COOLDOWN, or THEME_FOLLOW_FAILURE.

requiredRealtimeScannerRules.trigger: A cluster member is positive but lacks VWAP/high-rebreak confirmation.
requiredRealtimeScannerRules.action: Show as WATCH, not BUY; require intraday confirmation for ENTRY_READY.
Do not create AUTO_PAPER candidates; surface DATA_STALE diagnostics.

changes: LiveQuantPaperTradingScheduler now runs every minute during 09:00-15:59 KST when enabled.
The live paper scheduler is enabled by default unless QUANT_LIVE_PAPER_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false.
LiveQuantPaperTradingService blocks stale ranking candidate generation when latest market date is more than three calendar days behind signal date.
RealtimeStockSnapshotProvider reads current price/change-rate/trading-value snapshots from StockDetailService.
LG next-day cluster creates WATCH, COOLDOWN, and WARNING candidates from realtime snapshots without opening paper positions.
Only BUY candidates can open paper positions; WATCH/COOLDOWN/WARNING never buy.

modelCoverageConclusion.reason: KOSPI_BULL and KOSDAQ_BULL can cover positive momentum and some liquidity-ranked movers, but they do not fully cover crash defense, sideways mean reversion, gap-fade, leader-proxy rotation, or downside continuation.
